subject: Banking
title: Revolut: The Super App
description: Learn Revolut: The Super App in one minute.

hook.text: Revolut has 40 million users in 38 countries. It offers banking, crypto, stock trading, and insurance in one app.

buildup.text: Founded in London in 2015, Revolut started with free currency exchange.

discovery.text: Revolut's multi-currency account lets you hold 36 currencies. Traveling abroad costs zero in foreign exchange fees.

twist.text: Revolut's growth brought controversy. Reports of intense work culture and compliance gaps raised concerns about scaling.

climax.text: Revolut's strategy is to replace every financial app with one super app. More features, more data, more lock-in.

punchline.text: 40 million users. Banking, crypto, stocks, insurance. One app rules all.

quiz.question: What makes Revolut a 'super app'?
options: It combines banking, trading, crypto, and insurance in one app

details.summary: Revolut evolved from a foreign exchange card into a financial super app offering banking, crypto trading, stock investing, insurance, and travel bookings to over 35 million customers across Europe and beyond.
details.whyItMatters: Revolut's super app strategy tests whether one platform can replace banks, brokers, and insurance companies. If it succeeds, it could redefine what a financial institution looks like.
takeaways: Revolut has over 35 million customers and a $33 billion valuation
It offers over 30 financial products from a single app
Revolut secured a UK banking license in 2024 after years of effort

faq.question: What makes Revolut different from other neobanks?
faq.answer: Most neobanks focus on basic banking. Revolut offers currency exchange at interbank rates, crypto and stock trading, travel insurance, lounge access, and business accounts, mimicking the super app model successful in Asia.

faq.question: Is Revolut a real bank?
faq.answer: Revolut secured a UK banking license in 2024 and holds a Lithuanian banking license for European operations. In many markets it still operates as an electronic money institution with deposit protection through partner banks.
